_notes: Symmetric German contrast pairs — after an answer whose `pattern` matches a key, 70% probability the next question is drawn where `pattern === counterpart`, if available and unseen this session. Disabled in bosses and review mode. Pattern keys must exist in taxonomy.json (de/taxonomy.json). Heaviest cluster is around cases (Akk↔Dat) and the Perfekt↔Präteritum register split — German's two most consequential drilling axes.
_design_notes: Cases (Akk↔Dat) gets the heaviest pairing — the single biggest German confusion axis. Three explicit symmetric pairs across case-marking patterns, adjective declension, and reflexive pronouns.
Wechselpräpositionen (Akk for motion ↔ Dat for location) is a dedicated pair because the choice is fully driven by the underlying motion/location question.
Perfekt ↔ Präteritum mirrors FR passé-composé ↔ imparfait but with a different rationale: register split, not aspectual.
Separable ↔ inseparable prefix verbs catches the trennbar/untrennbar distinction (stehen auf vs verstehen).
Modal + bare infinitive ↔ main verb + zu-infinitive pairs the two competing infinitive constructions.
Sie ↔ du is doubled: once as a pronoun pattern, once as a register/social pattern — it shows up at both grammatical and pragmatic levels.
Konjunktiv II irreal-condition ↔ wenn-konditional pairs because wenn-clauses contain the Konjunktiv II verb form.
